diagnosis.cause: The same lexical cue, mission-critical, occurs in both required URLLC semantic groups. Therefore one phrase can satisfy both sides of the two-group rule.

evaluation_policy.family_evaluation: Re-evaluate frozen 20-case R6 family only after unit tests pass.
evaluation_policy.next_step: Implement in a new versioned resolver module.
evaluation_policy.runner_integration: Only after deterministic family evaluation passes.
evaluation_policy.then: Run deterministic residual and regression tests.

allowed: Add deterministic cue-match helper that returns matched lexical cues rather than only a boolean.
Require distinct matched cues across the two URLLC semantic groups.
Preserve the previously added mission-critical entries in URLLC_RELIABILITY_CONTROL.
not_allowed: Do not weaken the two-group rule.
Do not make mission-critical alone sufficient.
Do not make real-time alone sufficient.
Do not add new service vocabulary.

refinement.URLLC_rule: Require at least one delay/criticality cue and at least one reliability/control cue whose matched normalized cue strings are distinct.
refinement.principle: A semantic service signature requiring multiple cue groups must be supported by distinct matched lexical evidence. The same matched cue must not independently satisfy two required groups.

required_tests.intent: Create connectivity suitable for mission-critical real-time exchanges.
Provide high-capacity mobile broadband for mission-critical real-time exchanges.
